_comment: DEAL_ARCANE was used as a FLAG name and DEAL_ARCANE_AMOUNT as an amount; neither exists, so the search could never run and its cost cap was 0 regardless. 'The damage dealt by Lesson in Lava' is what ACTUALLY landed, not the printed 3 -- prevention and replacement effects change it -- so it reads the last dealt amount. The search puts the card ON TOP of the deck, which is why the destination is deck_top and not hand. Kano Specialization is a deckbuilding restriction (CR 8.3.7), never an in-game condition.

effects.prompt: Search your deck for a Wizard card to put on top?
